title: The template readiness verdict judges a WordPress release on the read side: JA Diner WP7 reads its kit, a copy without the kit is held
steps: S1: From the repo root run node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/template-readiness-wordpress-kit.test.mjs.
S2: Read the TAP lines for the named tests.
expect: The JA Diner WP7 template-kit piece reads the WordPress kit beside the contract.
A copy of JA Diner WP7 without its kit is held with kit-missing.
The kit reads each page as its sections and its theme accent as the brand colour; the header Site Logo block leaves no brand gap.
A copy whose header logo is not a Site Logo block still raises kit-brand-unreadable.

tests: JA Diner WP7: the template-kit piece reads the WordPress kit
a copy of JA Diner WP7 without its kit is held with kit-missing
JA Diner WP7: the kit reads each page as its sections
JA Diner WP7: the header logo is a Site Logo block
a copy whose header logo is not a Site Logo block still raises kit-brand-unreadable
